purpose: pre-specified extensions to D; no threshold search

definitions.D_long_spy_regime_rs20: LONG + prior completed SPY daily bull regime (>=2/3 close>EMA50, EMA20>EMA50, 20d return>0) + stock 20d return >= SPY 20d return
definitions.E_D_plus_breadth50: D + >=50% of available universe closes above EMA50 on latest completed daily bars
definitions.F_D_plus_spy_volshock_q90: D + completed SPY ATR14/close <= 90th percentile of preceding 252 completed SPY sessions
definitions.G_D_plus_cross_section_rs_top50: D + stock 20d return >= cross-sectional median 20d return of available universe at prior close
definitions.H_D_long_plus_bearish_short: D longs + SHORT only when prior completed SPY bear regime (>=2/3 close<EMA50, EMA20<EMA50, 20d return<0) and stock 20d return <= SPY 20d return

audit.note: Current 53-stock universe projected backward; survivorship/post-selection bias remains. Candidate definitions were chosen after observing D, so this is hypothesis testing, not pristine OOS proof.
